analysis_plan: Fixed before data collection. Primary question: do the four labels differ on spoke, words, uses_interest, uses_right, concedes, within moment, rule state, and name type? Permute labels within those strata (5000 permutations), summing between-label spread across strata, with Holm correction across the primary outcomes. Secondary: the same test within rule-on and rule-off separately, labelled versus no label, and neutral versus associated name. Exploratory and not corrected: uses_power, conditional_ask, mentions_identity, and male-coded versus female-coded names. uses_power and conditional_ask are exploratory because coder agreement was below 0.6. Replies are coded blind by anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.
